description: This file defines the UploadedFileInterface, an interface for representing uploaded files within an HTTP message context. It specifies methods for retrieving file streams, moving files, and accessing file metadata such as size, error status, client filename, and media type.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns a stream representing the uploaded file, or throws an exception if unavailable.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.description: Moves the uploaded file to a specified location, removing the original after the move.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of the uploaded file in bytes, or null if unknown.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the error status of the upload, using PHP's UPLOAD_ERR constants.

methods.name: getClientFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename sent by the client, or null if none.

methods.name: getClientMediaType
methods.description: Returns the media type sent by the client, or null if none.
